The multigroup statomatic workflow

Source: R/multigroup_main.R
multigroup_main.Rd

Sorts genes by residual normality and equality of variance, then runs the matching omnibus and post-hoc tests on each set: ne (normal, equal variance): Type II ANOVA + Tukey HSD nu (normal, unequal variance): Welch test + Dunnett T3 nn (not normal): Kruskal-Wallis + Dunn Post-hoc tests and fold changes compare every pair of groups, where a group is one combination of the factors (e.g. condition_sex). The ANOVA tests every main effect and interaction; Welch and Kruskal-Wallis are one-way tests on the combined groups. Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment (padj) is done within each set.

Usage

multigroup_main(
  x,
  sample_info,
  factors,
  sample_col = NULL,
  padj = TRUE,
  log_input = FALSE,
  shapiro_threshold = 0.05,
  levene_threshold = 0.05,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

x

a numeric data.frame or matrix, genes as rows, samples as named columns

sample_info

a data.frame with one row per sample. Samples are matched to the columns of x by name: through sample_col, the row names, or the column whose values are the sample IDs (found automatically). Rows for samples that are not in x are ignored.

factors

names of the columns of sample_info to use as factors: one (with 3+ levels, one-way) to three (three-way), e.g. c("condition", "sex")

sample_col

optional name of the column of sample_info with the sample IDs, needed only if several columns contain them

padj

logical, add Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-values

log_input

logical, TRUE if x is already log-transformed (fold changes are then differences of group means)

shapiro_threshold

significance level for the Shapiro-Wilk test

levene_threshold

significance level for the Levene test

verbose

logical, print a message for each step

Value

a list: anova_results, welch_results, kw_results: omnibus p-values, then for each comparison pvalue, padj and log2FoldChange, then group means and the post-hoc test name. A set with no genes gives a 0-row table with the same columns. foldchanges: fold changes and group means for all genes. ne, nu, nn: the subsets of x. tests: per-gene Shapiro and Levene p-values and the assigned set.
